weapon_synth_sound_engine89 v1.6.0 release manifest

Phase 3 additions:
  - physical Weapon DNA descriptor and ten default classes
  - deterministic correlated shot variation
  - whole-report DNA mapping across report/body/gas/crack/tail/thump
  - Realistic, Hybrid and Cinematic source/world synchronization
  - caller-owned fixed-point regression metrics
  - editable target envelopes, validation flags and Q15 score
  - five new facade events and engine bridge helpers
  - Phase 3 test, renderer, preview and metrics JSON
